title: The Art and Science of Moderating Discussions

reader_summary.headline: whether it's moderating a live panel discussion, managing your all-hands meeting.
reader_summary.overview: whether it's moderating a live panel discussion, managing your all-hands meeting, or even guiding a cross-functional team to a decision in an important meeting. In this episode from November 2020, expert communications and presentations coach Matt Abrams, who's also a lecturer at Stanford's Graduate School of Business. They cover everything from how to approach prep work, like, can you be too prepared, and how to handle disruptions on the fly.
